meaning.vi: Một ví dụ về nhắm mục tiêu.

(từ cổ,nghĩa cổ) khiên nhỏ, mộc nhỏ

sentences.en: So you were targeting the teenagers?

sentences.en: No more hunting, tracking, targeting, hurting, killing, or anything else.

sentences.en: Our ability to inspect efficiently and swiftly depends on accurate screening and targeting high-risk cargo.

sentences.en: Loyalist followers of the former dictator are accused of targeting Iraqis they perceive to be working with the U.S.-led coalition.
